query: INSERT INTO master_insurance_providers (tenant_id, code, name, provider_type, contact_phone, contact_email, website) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, provider_type = EXCLUDED.provider_type, contact_phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_phone, master_insurance_providers.contact_phone), contact_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_email, master_insurance_providers.contact_email), website = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website, master_insurance_providers.website), is_active = true
